nodes.label: review_file
nodes.summary: Choose approval or rejection; the decision waits for notification delivery.

nodes.label: review_notice_wait
nodes.summary: The selected decision has not taken effect.

nodes.label: deliver_review_notice

nodes.label: approved_file
nodes.summary: Only an effective approval allows the uploader to share.

nodes.label: rejected_file
nodes.summary: The file cannot be shared; the uploader and administrator retain access.

nodes.label: share_file
nodes.summary: Create a sharing request for a designated colleague.

nodes.label: share_notice_wait
nodes.summary: The designated recipient has no access from this request yet.

nodes.label: deliver_share_notice
nodes.summary: Write the recipient notification and activate the grant in one transaction.

nodes.label: active_share
nodes.summary: The effective grant applies to the designated recipient.

nodes.label: view_file
nodes.summary: File access is allowed for the uploader, administrator or an active designated recipient.

nodes.label: download_file
nodes.summary: Use the same access condition as file viewing.

nodes.label: message_list
nodes.summary: The uploader sees review results; the designated recipient sees share messages.
